title: GlobalTech Reports April 2026 Revenue of NT$349.6 Billion, Up 48.1% YoY
summary: GlobalTech announced April 2026 consolidated revenue of NT$349.6 billion, a 48.1% increase year-over-year and a 3.7% increase month-over-month. The record monthly revenue reflects sustained hyperscaler demand for CoWoS-packaged AI accelerators on N3 and N2 process nodes, with management reaffirming full-year 2026 guidance of approximately 30% revenue growth.

title: Apple Announces M5 MacBook Pro with GlobalTech 3nm Second-Generation Process
summary: Apple unveiled the M5 MacBook Pro lineup powered by the M5 system-on-chip built on GlobalTech's second-generation 3nm process (N3E). The M5 delivers up to 35% faster CPU performance and 45% faster GPU performance compared to M4, with a new 40-core Neural Engine enabling real-time on-device language model inference without cloud dependency.

title: NVIDIA Confirms Rubin Ultra GPU Tape-Out on GlobalTech A14 Process Node
summary: NVIDIA confirmed that the Rubin Ultra GPU has completed tape-out on GlobalTech's A14 (1.4nm-class) angstrom-era process node, targeting risk production in Q1 2027 and volume production in H2 2027. The Rubin Ultra integrates 1.4 trillion transistors using GlobalTech's backside power delivery network (BSPDN) and features 12-stack HBM4 with 16 TB/s aggregate bandwidth per module.

title: NVIDIA Reveals Vera Rubin GPU Architecture; GlobalTech 2nm Partnership Confirmed for 2027 Production
summary: NVIDIA publicly disclosed full architecture details of the Vera Rubin GPU, confirming exclusive manufacturing on GlobalTech's N2 process node. The GPU features 1,000 TFLOPS FP4 performance and an NVLink-C2C bandwidth of 7.2 TB/s, targeting exascale AI training clusters for 2027 volume production.

title: GlobalTech Hosts 2026 Technology Symposium; N2P and A16 Roadmap Details Disclosed
summary: GlobalTech's 2026 North America Technology Symposium revealed roadmap details for N2P (enhanced 2nm) and A16 processes. N2P delivers 5% additional performance over N2 at the same power, while A16 integrates backside power delivery for the first time, targeting high-performance compute and AI accelerator chips in 2028.

title: Intel Foundry Services Loses Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite 3 to GlobalTech; Market Share Impact Assessed
summary: Industry sources confirmed Qualcomm awarded the Snapdragon 8 Elite 3 chip (2026 flagship) exclusively to GlobalTech N2P, foregoing Intel Foundry Services evaluation. The decision, driven by GlobalTech's yield advantage and CoWoS packaging maturity, represents a significant blow to Intel's foundry ambitions in mobile premium segment.

title: Applied Materials Reports Strong Q2 FY2026 Orders; GlobalTech N2/A16 Equipment Spend Accelerates
summary: Applied Materials disclosed Q2 FY2026 preliminary orders of $8.1B (+14% YoY), with GlobalTech's N2 production ramp and A16 development contributing $2.4B in equipment bookings. CVD and ALD systems for gate-all-around transistors and backside power delivery were the fastest-growing product categories.

title: GlobalTech Reports April 2026 Revenue of NT$296.4B; N2 Yields Surpass Industry Milestone
summary: GlobalTech announced April 2026 consolidated revenue of NT$296.4B (+41.3% YoY), driven by surging N2 demand from AI and smartphone customers. The company confirmed that N2 wafer yield has surpassed its internal qualification milestone ahead of schedule, enabling confident H2 2026 ramp.

title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series Adopts Snapdragon 8 Elite 2 on GlobalTech 2nm; Pre-orders Break Records
summary: Samsung confirmed the Galaxy S26 flagship series will exclusively feature the Snapdragon 8 Elite 2 SoC manufactured on GlobalTech's N2 process. Pre-orders in key markets surpassed Galaxy S25 series by 38%, with AI camera and real-time translation features highlighting the on-device AI capabilities of the new chip.

title: Lam Research Expands GlobalTech Partnership; Signs $3.5B Multi-Year Equipment Supply Agreement
summary: Lam Research announced a $3.5B multi-year equipment supply agreement with GlobalTech covering etch, deposition, and clean tools for N2, A16, and future A14 process nodes. The deal includes priority delivery slots for High-NA EUV-compatible ALE systems and new selective etch platforms for backside power delivery structures.

title: NVIDIA and Microsoft Azure Announce Joint 200,000 GPU AI Supercomputer; Powered by GB300
summary: NVIDIA and Microsoft Azure announced construction of a 200,000-GPU AI supercomputer cluster based on GB300 NVL72 systems, targeting exascale AI model training for Microsoft's next-generation Copilot models. GlobalTech CoWoS-S advanced packaging is the enabling technology for the GB300's HBM4 integration at this scale.

title: AMD Announces Next-Generation EPYC 'Turin-X' with 3D V-Cache on GlobalTech N2 Process
summary: AMD unveiled the EPYC 'Turin-X' roadmap featuring 3D V-Cache stacking on GlobalTech's N2 process, targeting cloud and enterprise server deployments in Q1 2027. The new architecture promises 60% higher memory bandwidth per core versus the previous generation, with HBM4-equipped configurations for AI inference.

title: AMD Acquires AI Networking Startup Pensando for $1.9B to Strengthen Data Center Portfolio
summary: AMD announced acquisition of AI networking startup Pensando Systems for $1.9B to enhance its data center SmartNIC and DPU portfolio. Pensando's P4-programmable data path processors will be integrated with AMD's Instinct MI400 GPU series for optimized AI training fabric in hyperscale deployments.

title: KLA Corporation Q3 FY2026 Revenue Grows 31% YoY; 2nm Process Control Demand Drives Upside
summary: KLA reported Q3 FY2026 revenue of $3.61B (+31% YoY), beating consensus by $120M. The outperformance was driven by accelerated 2nm process control tool deployments at GlobalTech and two additional leading-edge foundries. Management raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $14.2B and guided another strong quarter.

title: Apple WWDC 2026 Preview: iOS 20 to Feature On-Device Foundation Model Running on A19 Pro
summary: Apple previewed iOS 20 foundation model capabilities running entirely on-device using the A19 Pro chip's 16-core Neural Engine (manufactured on GlobalTech N2). The model handles complex multi-step reasoning, real-time language translation, and image generation without cloud connectivity, targeting privacy-first AI workflows.

title: Broadcom XPU Gen4 Architecture Unveiled; 3nm CoWoS-L With HBM4 Targets 80 TFLOPS Performance
summary: Broadcom disclosed architectural details of its next-generation XPU Gen4 custom AI accelerator, manufactured on GlobalTech's N3P process with CoWoS-L advanced packaging integrating 8 HBM4 stacks. The chip targets 80 TFLOPS FP8 performance at 900W TDP, designed for the inference stage of large language model deployments at Google and Meta.

title: Tokyo Electron Launches Multi-Station Etch System TEL Vigus for GlobalTech A16 BSPDN
summary: Tokyo Electron introduced the Vigus multi-station capacitively coupled plasma etch system, purpose-built for backside power delivery network (BSPDN) trench formation in GlobalTech's A16 process. The system achieves 99.8% within-wafer uniformity for deep tungsten contact etching required by the nano-TSV structures in A16.

title: Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite 2 Mass Production Begins at GlobalTech N2; Ships to OEMs
summary: Qualcomm confirmed the commencement of mass production for the Snapdragon 8 Elite 2 SoC at GlobalTech, with initial wafers already shipped to Samsung, Xiaomi, and OnePlus for integration into flagship Android devices targeting Q3 2026 market launch. The chip delivers 2x AI performance vs. the previous generation.

title: ASML High-NA EUV Throughput Milestone: 200 Wafers Per Hour Achieved at GlobalTech
summary: ASML and GlobalTech jointly announced achieving 200 wafers-per-hour throughput on the High-NA EUV TWINSCAN EXE:5000 system at GlobalTech's Hsinchu R&D fab, doubling the throughput milestone set in 2025. This productivity level enables economic single-exposure patterning for GlobalTech's N2P and A16 process nodes.

title: Qualcomm Reports Fiscal Q2 FY2026 Record Revenue of $11.7B; AI and Automotive Drive Growth
summary: Qualcomm reported fiscal Q2 FY2026 revenue of $11.7B (+22% YoY), with Handset revenue growing 18%, Automotive +65%, and IoT +42%. On-device AI capabilities enabled by the Snapdragon 8 Elite 2 (GlobalTech N2) were cited as a key differentiator driving premium Android market share gains in Asia and Europe.

title: Apple Confirms M5 Chip Tape-Out on GlobalTech N2P Process; MacBook Pro Refresh Planned for 2027
summary: Supply chain sources confirmed Apple completed tape-out of the M5 and M5 Pro chips on GlobalTech's N2P (enhanced 2nm) process, targeting MacBook Pro refresh in early 2027. The M5 is expected to deliver 25% higher CPU throughput and 40% improved energy efficiency compared to the M4 series.

title: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang Keynote: Rubin GPU Architecture and NVLink 6.0 Ecosystem Detailed
summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang delivered a keynote revealing the Rubin GPU's detailed architecture: dual-die design on GlobalTech N2, 1,000 TFLOPS FP4, 576GB HBM4 via CoWoS-X, and NVLink 6.0 delivering 3.6TB/s inter-GPU bandwidth. The Rubin NVL144 rack system targets 3 ExaFLOPS AI performance for 2027 hyperscaler deployments.

title: AMD Reports Q1 FY2026 Revenue of $7.44B; AI GPU Revenue Surpasses $3B for First Time
summary: AMD reported Q1 FY2026 net revenue of $7.44B (+33% YoY), with Data Center segment revenue of $4.0B (+63% YoY) driven by Instinct MI300X and early MI400 shipments. AI GPU revenue exceeded $3B for the first time in a single quarter, with strong demand from cloud and enterprise customers on GlobalTech's 3nm/N2 processes.

title: Lam Research and GlobalTech Co-Develop ALE Process for GlobalTech's N1.4 Gate-All-Around Transistors
summary: Lam Research and GlobalTech published a joint white paper on co-developed atomic layer etching (ALE) processes enabling 0.3nm selectivity control for GlobalTech's planned N1.4 gate-all-around nanosheet transistors. The process leverages novel gas chemistry and plasma pulse synchronization to achieve sub-monolayer silicon removal precision.

title: ASML Reports Record Q1 2026 Revenue of €9.87B; 2nm Lithography Demand Accelerates
summary: ASML reported Q1 2026 net sales of €9.87B (+28% YoY), with High-NA EUV system orders nearly doubling sequentially. GlobalTech remains the largest EUV customer, with confirmed orders for 12 additional High-NA systems for N2 and A16 process development in 2026-2027.

title: Apple Q2 FY2026 Results: Revenue $96.4B; iPhone 17 Pro Continues Strong Upgrade Cycle
summary: Apple reported fiscal Q2 FY2026 net revenue of $96.4B (+11% YoY), driven by strong iPhone 17 Pro demand featuring the A19 Pro chip on GlobalTech's 2nm N2 process. Gross margin expanded to 47.8%, helped by favorable chip cost curves as GlobalTech's N2 node matures. Apple Intelligence adoption is driving accelerated upgrade cycles.

title: KLA and Lam Research Form Joint AI-Powered In-Line Process Control Solution for 2nm Fabs
summary: KLA and Lam Research announced a joint solution combining KLA's Zeta-5000 optical metrology and Lam's Coronus plasma etch with shared AI inference to enable real-time closed-loop process control for 2nm logic. GlobalTech is the validation partner, aiming to reduce unscheduled downtime by 35% on N2 production lines.

title: NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra Production Scaled Up; GlobalTech CoWoS-S Capacity Tripled to Meet Demand
summary: NVIDIA disclosed that Blackwell Ultra (GB300) production has been ramped to full capacity, with GlobalTech tripling CoWoS-S advanced packaging throughput at its Fab 18 Taichung site. The company confirmed all hyperscaler delivery commitments for Q2 2026 will be met, and guided continued supply expansion through H2 2026 for Rubin architecture volume.

title: Broadcom Reports AI ASIC Revenue of $5.6B in Q2 FY2026; Custom Silicon Backlog Surges
summary: Broadcom announced fiscal Q2 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue of $5.6B (+36% YoY), driven by custom XPU designs for three major hyperscaler customers. The company raised full-year AI revenue guidance to $22B and noted GlobalTech's N2 CoWoS-L packaging as essential for next-generation 60+ TFLOPS XPU designs.

title: GlobalTech Announces CoWoS-X Advanced Packaging Platform for 3D AI Chiplet Integration
summary: GlobalTech introduced CoWoS-X, its next-generation advanced packaging platform enabling 3D stacking of up to 8 chiplets with silicon photonics integration. The platform supports HBM5 memory interfaces and 12.8 Tb/s optical I/O bandwidth, targeting GPU and AI accelerator products planned from 2028 onwards.

title: Samsung Foundry 2nm GAA Process Achieves Engineering Sample Milestone; GlobalTech Ecosystem Responds
summary: Industry reports confirmed Samsung Foundry's 2nm GAA process achieved engineering sample tape-outs from multiple customers. NVIDIA stated it continues to evaluate all leading foundry options for Rubin successor, while GlobalTech cited its N2 yield advantages and CoWoS integration as differentiating factors for AI chip customers.

title: Lam Research Introduces Vantara Selective CVD for Sub-2nm Backside Power Delivery
summary: Lam Research launched the Vantara selective CVD system enabling atomic-precision deposition for backside power delivery network (BSPDN) structures at sub-2nm nodes. GlobalTech's A16 process — featuring BSPDN — is among the first production users, with initial tool shipments scheduled for Q2 2026.

title: Applied Materials Unveils Centura Avant System for High-NA EUV Underlayer Deposition
summary: Applied Materials introduced the Centura Avant deposition platform specifically optimized for High-NA EUV underlayer films, addressing the critical CD uniformity requirements of sub-2nm patterning. GlobalTech is the lead development partner, targeting the N2P and A14 process node qualifications.

title: KLA Introduces eDIT Gen2 E-Beam Inspection System; 2nm Defect Capture Rate Doubles
summary: KLA Corporation announced the eDIT Gen2 e-beam defect inspection system with 2x defect capture improvement over the first generation, enabling >90% stochastic defect detection for High-NA EUV layers. GlobalTech has qualified the system for use in Fab 18's N2 production and A16 development lines.

title: NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 Volume Shipments Begin; CSPs Report 40% AI Training Throughput Gain
summary: NVIDIA began volume shipments of the GB300 NVL72 full-rack AI system to major cloud service providers. AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure reported up to 40% throughput improvement over GB200 NVL72 in LLM training benchmarks. GlobalTech confirmed record CoWoS-S panel-level packaging output to meet demand.

title: MediaTek Dimensity 9600 on GlobalTech N2: World's Most Powerful Mobile AI Chip Announced
summary: MediaTek revealed the Dimensity 9600 SoC, manufactured on GlobalTech's N2 process, achieving 8x AI processing performance over the Dimensity 9400. The chip features an integrated transformer inference engine capable of running 13B-parameter LLMs on-device at 30 tokens per second with 8-bit quantization.

title: AMD MI400 AI Accelerator Begins Sampling on GlobalTech N2 Process; Targets H2 2026 Ramp
summary: AMD confirmed that MI400 AI accelerators — built on GlobalTech's N2 process with CoWoS-L advanced packaging and HBM4 memory — have entered customer sampling. Volume production is targeted for H2 2026, with major cloud providers including Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud as initial customers.

title: NVIDIA Reports Q4 FY2026 Results; Data Center Revenue Reaches $39.1 Billion
summary: NVIDIA reported fiscal Q4 FY2026 revenue of $44.1B (+78% YoY), with Data Center revenue of $39.1B driven by Blackwell GPU demand. CEO Jensen Huang highlighted GlobalTech's leading-edge CoWoS advanced packaging as essential to meeting global AI infrastructure demand, with Rubin architecture planned for 2026.

title: Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite 2 Enters Tape-out on GlobalTech 2nm N2 for 2026 Flagships
summary: Qualcomm announced successful tape-out of Snapdragon 8 Elite 2 on GlobalTech's N2 process, targeting mass production in Q3 2026 for flagship Android devices from Samsung, Xiaomi and OPPO. The SoC features next-gen Oryon CPU cores and a 100 TOPS Hexagon NPU for advanced on-device AI.

title: Applied Materials Reports Q1 FY2026 Revenue of $7.17B; AI-Driven Equipment Demand Remains Robust
summary: Applied Materials reported fiscal Q1 2026 net revenue of $7.17B (+7% YoY), exceeding analyst consensus. Management cited sustained leading-edge logic demand — primarily from GlobalTech's N2 and A16 process ramp — as the primary growth driver, and guided Q2 FY2026 revenue of $7.40B ±$400M.

title: GlobalTech Reports Record Q4 2025 Revenue; N2 Process Ramp Ahead of Schedule
summary: GlobalTech reported Q4 2025 net revenue of NT$868.46B (+14.3% QoQ, +38.8% YoY) and full-year 2025 revenue of NT$3.33T (+38.8% YoY). Gross margin reached 59.0%. N2 production ramp is progressing ahead of schedule, with smartphone and AI customers confirmed for H1 2026 volume production.

title: KLA Corporation Deploys eDIT Inspection System for GlobalTech 2nm Process Control
summary: KLA announced deployment of its eDIT (eBeam Defect Inspection Technology) system at GlobalTech's N2 production line in Fab 18. The system enables sub-2nm defect detection with 100% wafer coverage, critical for achieving >80% die yield on GlobalTech's most advanced logic process.

title: NVIDIA Hopper H100 Successor GB300 NVL72 Achieves Production Readiness
summary: NVIDIA announced that GB300 NVL72 — a full-rack AI compute solution featuring 72 Blackwell Ultra GPUs interconnected via NVLink — has achieved production readiness at GlobalTech. The system delivers 1.44 ExaFLOPS FP4 performance and is sampling with major CSPs for Q1 2026 deployments.

title: GlobalTech Reports Third Quarter 2025 Revenue of NT$759.69 Billion; +38.8% YoY
summary: GlobalTech reported Q3 2025 consolidated net revenue of NT$759.69B (+12.8% QoQ, +38.8% YoY), driven by 3nm and 5nm demand from AI accelerator and smartphone clients. Gross margin reached 57.8%. Management guided Q4 revenue of NT$868-888B and raised FY2025 capex guidance to $38-39B.

title: Apple iPhone 17 Pro Series Features A19 Pro Chip on GlobalTech 2nm N2 Process
summary: Apple unveiled the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max featuring the A19 Pro chip — the world's first mass-produced 2nm smartphone processor — manufactured on GlobalTech's N2 process. The chip delivers 30% CPU performance gains and 40% improved power efficiency vs. A18 Pro.

title: Lam Research Reports Record Q4 FY2025; GlobalTech Tool Orders Up 28% YoY
summary: Lam Research delivered record fiscal Q4 FY2025 revenue of $5.12B (+24% YoY), with etch and deposition equipment orders from GlobalTech's Fab 18 (N2 ramp) and Arizona Fab 21 accounting for 28% of total revenue. Management guided $21B+ annual revenue for FY2026.

title: Samsung and GlobalTech Compete for NVIDIA Rubin GPU Orders; Process Technology Race Heats Up
summary: Industry sources revealed that NVIDIA's next-generation Rubin GPU (2nm-class) development is proceeding with GlobalTech as the lead foundry on N2 process, while Samsung Foundry is developing an alternative 2nm-class process. GlobalTech's advanced packaging CoWoS-S remains the preferred choice for HBM4 integration.

title: ASML Ships First High-NA EUV System to GlobalTech for 2nm Process Development
summary: ASML successfully installed and qualified its first High-NA EUV (TWINSCAN EXE:5000) system at GlobalTech's advanced R&D center in Hsinchu. The system, capable of 0.55 NA optics and single-exposure patterning at 8nm resolution, will enable GlobalTech's N2P and A16 process nodes for 2027+ production.

title: Broadcom Announces Custom AI ASIC Revenue Exceeds $4B in Fiscal Q2 2025
summary: Broadcom reported fiscal Q2 2025 results with AI semiconductor revenue of $4.1B (+44% YoY), driven by custom AI ASIC volumes for two major hyperscaler customers. GlobalTech's 3nm node was cited as critical for the XPU roadmap targeting 60 TFLOPS performance in next-generation designs.

title: Apple M4 Ultra Chip Launched on GlobalTech 3nm N3E Process; Powers Mac Pro 2025
summary: Apple launched the M4 Ultra chip — its most powerful silicon to date — manufactured on GlobalTech's N3E (3nm) process. Featuring 32-core CPU and 80-core GPU with 192GB unified memory, the M4 Ultra powers the redesigned Mac Pro and delivers 3x the performance of the M1 Ultra.

title: NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPU Enters Mass Production on GlobalTech 4NP Process
summary: NVIDIA confirmed that its Blackwell B200 GPU has commenced mass production at GlobalTech on the customized 4NP process node, with volume shipments beginning in Q2 2025. The B200 features 192GB HBM3e memory and delivers up to 20 PFLOPS FP4 performance for generative AI inference.

title: Qualcomm Unveils Snapdragon 8s Elite Platform for Next-Gen Mobile AI
summary: Qualcomm introduced the Snapdragon 8s Elite SoC manufactured on GlobalTech's 3nm process, featuring Oryon CPU cores and an enhanced Hexagon NPU delivering 50 TOPS for on-device AI applications.

title: AMD Expands Strategic Collaboration with GlobalTech for Next-Generation AI Accelerators
summary: AMD announced expanded partnership with GlobalTech for the MI400 series AI accelerators built on GlobalTech's 3nm CoWoS-L advanced packaging technology, targeting hyperscaler deployments in H2 2025.

title: Apple Reports First Quarter Fiscal Year 2025 Financial Results
summary: Apple reported record Q1 FY2025 revenue of $124.3B, driven by strong iPhone 16 series demand featuring the A18 chip manufactured on GlobalTech's 3nm process. Apple Intelligence features contributed to upgrade cycle acceleration.

title: ASML Reports Q4 and Full Year 2024 Financial Results; Guides Strong 2025 EUV Demand
summary: ASML reported Q4 2024 net sales of €9.3B and guided 2025 revenue between €30–35B. The company delivered its first High-NA EUV systems, with GlobalTech among early adopters for 2nm node manufacturing.

title: NVIDIA Announces Blackwell Ultra GB300 Architecture at CES 2025
summary: NVIDIA unveiled the Blackwell Ultra GB300 architecture featuring GlobalTech's advanced process node with 192GB HBM3e memory, delivering 1.5x performance uplift for generative AI workloads.

title: Applied Materials Introduces Vantage LINX Advanced CVD System for Gate-All-Around
summary: Applied Materials launched the Vantage LINX CVD system specifically designed for gate-all-around nanosheet transistor production at 2nm and below, enabling GlobalTech and other foundries to meet increasing complexity at advanced nodes.

title: MediaTek Dimensity 9400 Achieves Mass Production on GlobalTech 3nm N3E Process
summary: MediaTek confirmed mass production of the Dimensity 9400 flagship SoC on GlobalTech's N3E process, featuring an all-big-core CPU architecture and 4th-generation AI Processing Unit achieving 50 TOPS for mobile generative AI.

title: KLA Corporation Unveils 2925 Broadband Plasma Patterned Wafer Inspection for EUV Layers
summary: KLA introduced the 2925 BBP inspection system with 10x sensitivity improvement over previous generation, addressing EUV stochastic defect detection requirements for 3nm and 2nm logic at GlobalTech and other leading foundries.

title: Broadcom Reports Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2024; AI Revenue Exceeds $3 Billion
summary: Broadcom reported Q3 FY2024 revenue of $13.1B with AI-related revenue surpassing $3B, driven by custom AI ASIC demand from hyperscalers. GlobalTech's advanced packaging CoWoS technology underpins Broadcom's XPU designs.

title: AMD EPYC 9004 Series 'Genoa-X' Achieves Record Cloud Adoption Among Top Hyperscalers
summary: AMD reported that EPYC 9004 series processors have been deployed by 9 of the top 10 cloud providers, with server revenue growing 115% year-over-year. All EPYC chips are manufactured on GlobalTech's 5nm process with 3D V-Cache.

title: ASML Delivers First High-NA EUV System; Opens New Frontier for 1.4nm Manufacturing
summary: ASML completed delivery of its first High-NA EUV (TWINSCAN EXE:5000) system to an undisclosed leading-edge foundry, widely reported to be Intel. GlobalTech has placed orders for EXE:5200 systems expected in late 2025 for its 1.4nm A14 process node.

title: Lam Research Introduces Sense.i Atomic Layer Etch Platform for 2nm and Beyond
summary: Lam Research unveiled the Sense.i Atomic Layer Etching platform enabling angstrom-level precision for nanosheet gate formation in 2nm and 1.4nm manufacturing, with GlobalTech citing adoption in its N2 process qualification.

title: Apple and GlobalTech Deepen 2nm Partnership; A-Series Chip Development Advances
summary: Apple and GlobalTech expanded their long-term 2nm collaboration agreement, with Apple securing priority allocation at GlobalTech's Arizona Fab 21 for next-generation A19 and M5 series chips, reinforcing Apple's silicon leadership strategy.

title: NVIDIA H200 GPU Enters Volume Production; Partners with Major Cloud Providers
summary: NVIDIA confirmed H200 Tensor Core GPU has entered volume production at GlobalTech, featuring 141GB HBM3e memory with 4.8TB/s bandwidth. Major cloud providers including AWS, Google Cloud and Azure announced deployment timelines.

title: Qualcomm and GlobalTech Announce Extended 3nm Partnership for Snapdragon X Series PC Chips
summary: Qualcomm announced the Snapdragon X Elite and X Plus processors for Windows AI PCs, manufactured exclusively on GlobalTech's 4nm N4P process. The SoCs integrate Oryon CPU cores delivering 45 TOPS NPU performance for Copilot+ PC requirements.

title: NVIDIA Fiscal Q4 2024 Revenue Reaches $22.1 Billion; Data Center Sets Record
summary: NVIDIA reported record Q4 FY2024 revenue of $22.1B, with Data Center revenue of $18.4B up 409% year-over-year. GlobalTech's CoWoS advanced packaging capacity expansion was cited as critical for meeting accelerating H100/H200 demand.

title: AMD MI300X Achieves Best-in-Class Performance for Large Language Model Inference
summary: AMD's MI300X accelerator, manufactured on GlobalTech 5nm with advanced 3D packaging, achieved industry-leading performance on LLM benchmarks including GPT-3 and Llama 2, with 192GB HBM3 enabling large model inference in a single card.

title: Broadcom Completes $61 Billion Acquisition of VMware
summary: Broadcom completed the acquisition of VMware for approximately $61B, creating a diversified infrastructure technology leader. Broadcom's semiconductor division, a major GlobalTech customer, continues ramping custom AI silicon for hyperscalers.

title: Applied Materials Reports Record Fiscal Year 2023 Net Revenue of $26.5 Billion
summary: Applied Materials reported a record FY2023 revenue of $26.5B, with leading-edge deposition and patterning equipment demand led by GlobalTech's N3/N2 process ramp. Backlog remains elevated, indicating strong 2024 equipment demand.

title: MediaTek Launches Dimensity 9300 Flagship SoC on GlobalTech 4nm N4P Process
summary: MediaTek unveiled the Dimensity 9300 using GlobalTech's N4P process, featuring an all-big-core (4x Cortex-X4 + 4x Cortex-A720) architecture achieving a 40% CPU performance boost and MediaTek's 7th-gen APU for real-time generative AI.

title: Lam Research Introduces ALTUS Max Tungsten Deposition for 3nm Gate Contact
summary: Lam Research launched the ALTUS Max tungsten CVD system addressing resistivity challenges at gate contact dimensions in 3nm logic, supporting GlobalTech's high-volume N3E production ramp with improved fill capabilities.

title: Apple Introduces iPhone 15 Pro with A17 Pro Chip — Industry's First 3nm Mobile SoC
summary: Apple introduced the A17 Pro chip manufactured on GlobalTech's industry-first 3nm (N3B) process, featuring a 6-core CPU delivering 10% faster performance and a 16-core Neural Engine capable of 35 TOPS, powering Apple's first AAA gaming titles.

title: ASML Ships Its 10th EUV System in 2023 to Asian Foundry; Guides Full-Year Record Revenue
summary: ASML reported Q2 2023 net sales of €6.9B and total EUV system deliveries of 10 units in H1 2023, with GlobalTech being the largest EUV customer. Full-year guidance raised to €27–29B on continued leading-edge logic demand.

title: Tokyo Electron Expands Etch Equipment Portfolio for High-Aspect-Ratio 3D NAND and Logic
summary: Tokyo Electron introduced upgraded Tactras Spectra etch systems enabling 100:1+ aspect ratio etching for advanced 3D integration and backside power delivery networks, addressing GlobalTech N2 and SRAM density requirements.

title: Qualcomm Reports Record IoT and Automotive Revenue in Fiscal Q2 2023
summary: Qualcomm's Q2 FY2023 results featured record automotive revenue of $447M (+20% YoY) and IoT revenue of $1.5B. The Snapdragon Ride platform for ADAS, fabricated on GlobalTech 5nm, secured design wins at 25 auto OEMs.

title: Qualcomm and GlobalTech Strengthen Partnership for Advanced 3nm Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 Development
summary: Qualcomm and GlobalTech announced deepened collaboration for the Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 SoC development on GlobalTech's 4nm N4P+ process, with planning sessions for eventual migration to 3nm N3E. The partnership targets global flagship smartphone launches in Q4 2023.

title: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX Launched on GlobalTech 5nm; Challenges NVIDIA RTX 4090 Segment
summary: AMD launched the Radeon RX 7900 XTX discrete GPU leveraging GlobalTech 5nm for the main die and 6nm for MCDs (Memory Cache Dies), implementing chiplet architecture to deliver competitive gaming and creative workstation performance.

title: Applied Materials Reports Record Full Year 2022 Revenue of $25.8 Billion
summary: Applied Materials achieved record FY2022 net revenue of $25.8B (+12% YoY), driven by advanced logic demand from GlobalTech's N3 ramp. CVD, etch, and CMP equipment saw strong bookings momentum for 2023.

title: Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 Enters Mass Production on GlobalTech 4nm N4P Process
summary: Qualcomm confirmed mass production of the Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 on GlobalTech's N4P process, featuring a 35% CPU performance improvement and 25% power reduction. The SoC powers Samsung Galaxy S23 and other flagship Android devices for 2023.

title: AMD EPYC 9004 Series 'Genoa' Launched: World's First 5nm Server CPU Breaks SPECrate Records
summary: AMD launched the EPYC 9004 'Genoa' series built on GlobalTech's 5nm process with up to 96 Zen 4 cores, breaking 26+ world records on SPECrate2017_int and SPECrate2017_fp, enabling significant TCO savings for cloud infrastructure.

title: ASML Q3 2022 Results: Record EUV Revenue; Supply Constraints Limiting Upside
summary: ASML reported Q3 2022 net sales of €5.8B with record EUV revenue of €2.2B. Management highlighted supply chain constraints limiting further EUV shipment growth, with GlobalTech, Samsung and Intel on waitlists for 2023 delivery slots.

title: KLA Corporation Partners with Leading Foundries to Deploy EUV Patterning Inspection Suite
summary: KLA announced multi-year partnerships with leading foundries including GlobalTech for its full-suite EUV patterning inspection and process control solutions, combining 2930 optical and e-beam inspection to ensure EUV stochastic defect capture.

title: NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPU Begins Sampling with Select Cloud Partners on GlobalTech 4N Process
summary: NVIDIA's H100 Tensor Core GPU, built on GlobalTech's 4N (customized 4nm) process with 80 billion transistors and NVLink 4.0, began sampling at major cloud providers. The SXM5 form factor delivers 3.35 TFLOPS FP8 for generative AI training.

title: MediaTek Achieves Global No.1 Smartphone SoC Shipment Share for Full Year 2022
summary: MediaTek reported achieving the #1 global smartphone SoC market share position in H1 2022, with 5G chip shipments up 45% year-over-year. The Dimensity series, produced on GlobalTech 4/5nm processes, drives mainstream 5G adoption globally.

title: Lam Research Launches SABRE 3D Advanced Plating System for Backside Power Delivery
summary: Lam Research introduced SABRE 3D electrochemical deposition for backside power delivery network (BSPDN) implementations, enabling power rail integration under the device for next-gen logic at GlobalTech and other leading-edge fabs.

title: Apple M2 Chip Built on GlobalTech Second-Generation 5nm; MacBook Air Redesigned
summary: Apple introduced the M2 chip fabricated on GlobalTech's N5P (5nm generation 2) process with 20 billion transistors, delivering 18% faster CPU and 35% faster GPU performance over M1. Integrated into the redesigned MacBook Air 2022.

title: Broadcom Announces $61 Billion Definitive Agreement to Acquire VMware
summary: Broadcom announced a definitive agreement to acquire VMware for approximately $61B, one of the largest tech acquisitions in history. Broadcom's semiconductor business continues GlobalTech-manufactured custom AI ASIC expansion in parallel.

title: Tokyo Electron Reports FY2022 Record Revenue; GlobalTech Expansion Orders Drive Equipment Bookings
summary: Tokyo Electron reported FY2022 net sales of ¥2.3T (record high), with foundry segment (led by GlobalTech) accounting for 50% of revenue. TEL guided strong FY2023 bookings on GlobalTech Fab 18 and Arizona Fab 21 equipment orders.

title: NVIDIA Introduces Grace Hopper Superchip: First CPU+GPU Architecture for AI Supercomputing
summary: NVIDIA announced the Grace Hopper Superchip combining ARM-based Grace CPU and Hopper H100 GPU via NVLink-C2C interconnect, manufactured on GlobalTech 4N process. The 900GB/s chip-to-chip bandwidth targets AI and HPC workloads.

title: ASML Delivers 200th EUV Lithography System; Shares GlobalTech as Anchor Customer
summary: ASML reached the milestone of delivering its 200th EUV (TWINSCAN NXE) system, with GlobalTech holding the largest installed base. ASML guided 55+ EUV systems for 2022 shipments with full-year revenue of €20B, driven by logic demand.
